subject: MAP: Security questionnaire & SOC 2 evidence — owners + due dates
messages:
From: Amelia Torres <amelia.torres@bankly.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@bankly.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — Security milestone first pass

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the call today — good conversation. As discussed, Bankly's InfoSec team prefers a single consolidated questionnaire and a short evidence inventory that maps directly to the SOC 2 controls. Can you share an initial draft of the questionnaire and a template for evidence so we can assign owners?

High level timeline we discussed on the call:
- Questionnaires back to Bankly by Aug 6
- Evidence collected by Aug 27
- Security review complete by Sep 10

A couple of clarifying notes from our side:
- We'll need to review KMS/HSM details and token handling for PII redaction.
- Audit log retention policy and log access is a separate follow-up — Sanjay will own that.

Appreciate a MAP-style milestone table so we can insert our owners and track dependencies.

Best,
Amelia
Amelia Torres
Director, Information Security | Bankly

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Torres <amelia.torres@bankly.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@bankly.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — Security milestone first pass

Amelia — thanks, and great talking with you all. Attaching a first-pass MAP snippet focused on the security milestone plus the questionnaire and a starter evidence inventory template (attached). Summary below: 

MAP (security milestone) — draft owners & dates
- Deliverable: Redwood SOC 2 questionnaire (v1) — Owner: laura_bennett — Due: 2027-08-06
- Deliverable: Evidence inventory (template) — Owner: rafael_mendes — Due: 2027-08-10
- Deliverable: Bankly to assign evidence owners and return completed inventory — Owner: Amelia (Bankly) — Due: 2027-08-27
- Deliverable: Security review follow-up call (technical deep dive) — Owner: karthik_iyer — Target meeting week: 2027-09-06
- Deliverable: Final SOC 2 package delivery for procurement review — Owner: laura_bennett — Target: 2027-09-10

Dependencies called out: KMS/HSM diagrams and key rotation schedule (Bankly wants this early), and production access for audit-log samples (requested but gated by legal/contract).

Next steps (from Redwood):
1) Rafael will send the evidence template today (attached).
2) Laura will push the questionnaire v1 to you by Aug 6 and highlight any ask that requires engineering artifacts.
3) Karthik will prepare the technical deep-dive agenda and proposed attendees.

If that timeline looks off for Bankly, please propose adjustments — we'll move dates in the MAP accordingly.

Thanks — laura
Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: evidence_inventory_template.xlsx (spreadsheet; 1 sheet), Bankly_SOC2_Questionnaire_v1.pdf

From: rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Torres <amelia.torres@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence template populated — quick clarifications

Amelia / Laura — I populated the evidence template with the items we typically provide (config screenshots, retention statements, third-party attestations). A couple of quick clarifications before Bankly assigns owners: 

- "KV cache retention" entry — this is a runtime optimization detail; do you want this grouped under "Infrastructure / Runtime" or under "Data Handling"?
- For KMS materials we can provide KMS architecture diagram + key rotation cadence. Is a high-level diagram sufficient or do you need vendor console screenshots (we can redact identifiers)?

I've flagged three items as "needs engineering"; if Bankly prefers to own collecting those artifacts we can mark them as "Bankly-gather" in the MAP.

Rafael
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Amelia Torres <amelia.torres@bankly.com>
To: rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@bankly.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence template populated — quick clarifications

Thanks Rafael — this looks good. A few clarifications from InfoSec: 

- Please keep KV cache retention under "Infrastructure / Runtime".
- KMS: high-level architecture diagram is fine for now; vendor console screenshots only if we need to validate specific key IDs.
- Bankly will own collecting application-level logs; Redwood to provide log schema and an example sample.

We will populate the attached inventory and return by Aug 27 — facing a short delay on legal review but still plan to meet Aug 27.

Amelia

- Evidence inventory (completed by Bankly): returned 2027-08-27 — Completed
- Technical deep-dive scheduled: week of Sep 6 — Completed (notes attached)

1) Laura to share final SOC 2 package (redacted console screenshots + KMS diagram) — target Sep 14.
2) Karhthik to confirm attendees and recordings from the Sep 6 technical deep-dive — completed, recording uploaded to the shared drive.
3) Rafael to attach evidence artifacts we own and mark "Redwood-provide" in the inventory.
